description: A four-way mineshaft junction: wood-framed east-west gallery crossing a north-south rail shaft, support posts, an ore cart sitting on the rails. 22x9px.
notes: Wood framing pattern matches world.lua's existing mineshaftHere() (roof/floor plank + posts) so a generated junction blends with the plain mineshaft corridors either side of it; ore cart + rails are the imported Terraria/Minecraft convention Drew asked for.
